format: Full Bakery in a Traditional Location

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Full Bakery franchise ranges from $256,950 to $703,500 in a Traditional Location and from $196,250 to $715,100 in a Non-Traditional Location. This includes $35,659 to $60,367 that must be paid to us or our affiliates.

fee.quote: When you sign a Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an initial franchise fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") of $35,500 for a Full Bakery, $8,000 for an Express Bakery, $5,500 for a Concession Bakery
fee.note: VetFran: Initial Franchise Fee for a Full Bakery is $20,000 for qualifying veterans or members of the Armed Forces. May be reduced case by case; in 2025 franchisees paid $1,000 to $30,500. Co-branded (Auntie Anne's or Carvel) $71,000, half to the other brand.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 6% of Net Sales, except: Auntie Anne's Co-Branded Bakeries in Other Locations: 6% of Net Sales attributed to Cinnabon; 7% of Net Sales attributed to Auntie Anne's ... Express Bakeries in a Schlotzsky's: then-current product price per case

adFund.quote: Advertising Contribution Bakeries in Other Locations (except Auntie Anne's Co-Branded Bakeries): Currently, 2.5% of Net Sales ... Bakeries in Streetside Locations: Currently, 3% of Net Sales
adFund.note: 2.5% in Other Locations, 3% in Streetside Locations and Swirl Bakeries. Local Marketing Obligation currently not less than 1% of Net Sales; Advertising Contribution plus Local Marketing Obligation capped at 5% of Net Sales.

otherRecurring.name: POS System License and Lease Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $159 to $397 per month (CapEx Program) and $302 to $967 per month (HaaS Program)

transferFee.amount: 50% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee if it is a Control Transfer; if it is a transfer to a related party or that is not a Control Transfer, 10% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee.

issues: Item 19 has no system-wide average; headline is the Enclosed Mall group. Franchised outlets jump +308 in 2025 (1,002 to 1,310) without explanation in the extracted Item 20 text; not verified. Transfer fee only as % of IFF.
